overview:
This check monitors [Hyper-V][1] through the Datadog Agent.

**Minimum Agent version:** 6.9.0

[1]: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/virtualization/hyper-v/hyper-v-on-windows-server
setup:
### Installation

The Hyper-V check is included in the [Datadog Agent][2] package. No additional installation is needed on your server.

### Configuration

1. Edit the `hyperv.d/conf.yaml` file, in the `conf.d/` folder at the root of your Agent's configuration directory to collect your Hyper-V performance data. See the [sample hyperv.d/conf.yaml][3] for all available configuration options.

2. [Restart the Agent][4].

**Note**: Versions 1.5.0 or later of this check use a new implementation for metric collection, which requires Python 3. For hosts that are unable to use Python 3, or if you would like to use a legacy version of this check, refer to the following [config][9].

### Validation

[Run the Agent's status subcommand][5] and look for `hyperv` under the Checks section.

[2]: /account/settings/agent/latest
[3]: https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/blob/master/hyperv/datadog_checks/hyperv/data/conf.yaml.example
[4]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/agent/guide/agent-commands/#start-stop-and-restart-the-agent
[9]: https://github.com/DataDog/integrations-core/blob/7.33.x/hyperv/datadog_checks/hyperv/data/conf.yaml.example
[5]: https://docs.datadoghq.com/agent/guide/agent-commands/#agent-status-and-information

metrics.name: hyperv.dynamic_memory_balancer.available_memory
metrics.description: The amount of memory left on the node.

metrics.name: hyperv.dynamic_memory_balancer.average_pressure
metrics.description: This counter represents the average pressure in the VM.

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_logical_processor.context_switches_per_sec
metrics.description: The combined rate at which all processors on the computer are switched from one thread to another.

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_logical_processor.guest_run_time
metrics.description: The percentage of time spent by the processor in guest code.

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_logical_processor.hypervisor_run_time
metrics.description: The percentage of time spent by the processor in hypervisor code.

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_logical_processor.idle_time

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_logical_processor.total_run_time

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_root_virtual_processor.guest_run_time
metrics.description: The percentage of time spent by the virtual processor in guest code.

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_root_virtual_processor.hypervisor_run_time
metrics.description: The percentage of time spent by the virtual processor in hypervisor code.

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_root_virtual_processor.total_run_time
metrics.description: The percentage of time spent by the virtual processor in guest and hypervisor code.

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_virtual_processor.guest_run_time

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_virtual_processor.hypervisor_run_time

metrics.name: hyperv.hypervisor_virtual_processor.total_run_time

metrics.description: The number of physical pages allocated.

metrics.name: hyperv.vm_vid_partition.remote_physical_pages
metrics.description: The number of physical pages not allocated from the preferred NUMA node.
